doc_id: AB-2025-02456-RFP #25-004ERP Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review_Final (1)

submission_deadline.note: Cover and RFP Timetable / Submission section.

rfp_contact.value: Indra Ghosh, Supervisor of Purchasing and Treasury; PublicBids@rockyview.ca

submission_method.value: Electronic submission by email to PublicBids@rockyview.ca; proposal in PDF.

contract_term.value: From official acceptance until December 31, 2025; renewable in one-year increments, with total term not to exceed 3 years.
contract_term.note: Section 1.3 Type of Contract for Deliverables.

scope_of_deliverables.value: Consulting engagement to assess Rocky View County's ERP requirements and organizational/technology/data/process readiness, document functional and technical requirements, develop the future ERP RFP scope, and advise the County during ERP vendor evaluation and selection.
scope_of_deliverables.note: Appendix D, Sections A1-A3; project phases include readiness assessment, RFP development, and evaluation/advisory support.

value: Completed and signed Submission Form (Appendix B).
Completed Pricing Schedule (Appendix D / Appendix C instructions).
Completed Mandatory Evaluation Table with Yes/No responses covering scope understanding, methodology, schedule, team, similar work, budgetary control, and required insurance/documents/references.

mandatory_technical_requirements.note: No separate mandatory technical solution-requirements section is stated; this procurement is for ERP consulting/advisory services. Do not convert rated methodology/experience criteria into technical mandatories.

value.criterion: Work Plan, Methodology, and Quality Assurance

evaluation_criteria.note: Appendix D Section C; total weighting 100%.

minimum_score_threshold.note: No explicit numeric minimum score to advance. Mandatory Yes/No items may disqualify, but there is no numeric rated-score cutoff.

pricing_structure.value: Complete the Pricing Schedule; provide unit prices and total/lump-sum bid in CAD. Rates are all-inclusive of labour, materials, travel, insurance, delivery/setup and overhead, with sales taxes itemized separately. Pricing is weighted 25%.
pricing_structure.note: Appendix C Pricing and Appendix D Pricing/Professional Fees.

insurance_requirements.note: An insurance certificate is referenced as required, but the PDF does not state a minimum insurance coverage type/amount. Do not invent a dollar minimum.

vendor_experience_required.value: Project Manager (and backup Project Manager) must have at least 5 years of experience on ERP-related projects and must have led at least 2 ERP projects from readiness assessment through implementation within the last 7 years. Project team members must have at least 3 years of experience on ERP-related projects, with readiness-assessment-through-implementation experience within the last 7 years. Relevant professional qualifications/certifications and public-sector/municipal ERP experience are evaluated.
vendor_experience_required.note: Appendix D rated criteria, Team Qualifications and Experience. This RFP contains explicit minimum experience requirements for the Project Manager and project team.

references_required.note: Minimum three similar/identical client references, preferably public sector, for services within the last seven years.

data_security_requirements.note: The consultant must assess the County's data security/governance and cloud-security readiness, but the RFP does not impose a named security/privacy compliance standard on the consultant's own hosted solution.

data_hosting_residency.note: The scope asks the consultant to assess data-residency requirements for a future ERP; it does not prescribe where the consultant must host/process County data.

vendor_demonstration_required.note: Section 2.6 states a second-level presentation/interview may be conducted for all or shortlisted proponents.
